observation: The model loader attempted a sandbox-blocked Hugging Face metadata request despite a local pinned cache. The tool session did not return a complete result log; four uninspected transient files were present when the run directory was reset.
remediation: The recorded Stage 16 run was restarted from an empty output directory with local_files_only=true, using the already cached pinned MiniLM revision.
limitation: The transient first-attempt files cannot be reconstructed. The retained local-only run is the authoritative, reproducible development record.
